request: Add a toggle between the existing 8K Night Earth and public/textures/earth-blue-marble-8k.jpg in the temporary Earth composition helper.

implementation.scope: Helper Earth model buttons select Night Earth (city lights) or Blue Marble (land, ocean and photographic clouds). Production remains night at 120° / 25° / 22.5° and 0.003 rad/s.
implementation.rendering: In-place surface/material/atmosphere replacement in the same scene and Earth group; no full scene reconstruction. Day uses the retained Lambert sun/ambient illumination and two atmosphere shells; night restores its unlit photograph and approved cinematic atmosphere.
implementation.preservation: Same geographic quaternion, chosen opening, elapsed frame, rotation rate, preview multiplier/play state, world camera, sky clock and shared geometry. Presets work for both maps; existing light-coverage recommendations are explicitly night-only.
implementation.loading: Only chosen texture loads. Old surface retained until replacement success, then old bitmap/texture/material released. Latest request wins, superseded request aborts, late decoded bitmaps close, error keeps prior map and offers retry. No persistent two-map texture cache.
implementation.portableSettings: Version 2 adds earthAppearance (day/night); strict version 1 imports select night. Import validates all fields and waits for successfully loaded requested model before applying pose/rate. Failed or superseded imports do not overwrite a later angle choice. Export omits simulated elapsed/fast-forward unless frame is explicitly adopted.
implementation.persistence: No database/browser-storage writes; choice restores after reading-view renderer recreation, refresh returns production default.
implementation.diagnostics: Actual/requested appearance, loading/error and texture request count exposed. Model switch resets samples and refreshes cached scene inventory; no claimed performance improvement.

resourceNotes: JPEG file lengths and dimensions are asset facts; 178,956,972 bytes per active mipmapped map is nominal RGBA8 storage, not measured process/GPU memory.
Transient old/new decoded bitmap coexistence is possible during replacement. No permanent dual-map cache; HTTP cache may serve revisits but decoding/upload still required.
Day retains one additional atmospheric mesh pass and two non-shadow-casting lights. No CPU/GPU, heat, battery, decode/upload benchmark or speedup claim.
No held performance-ledger candidate was implemented.

visualEvidence.engine: Hidden built-in Chromium only; actual application rendering, no user-screen/native Safari capture
visualEvidence.timing: Opening captures paused at 0:00; copied-settings check retained 2× saved speed, 30× preview and a 1-second frame across a model change. Playback switch verified advancing time, then paused at 5:31 in keyboard-playback-portrait. Stars/camera hover were not frozen; these are appearance checks, not pixel-perfect or performance comparisons.
visualEvidence.baseline: night-before-wide.jpg captured before runtime appearance implementation; night-after-wide.jpg after a day→night round trip. Other files use final renderer/helper code, with shorter final preset prose replacing the preliminary helper capture.
